text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Daiwa Scarlet—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That crane game over there. Look, the 
prize is a Paka Petit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Daiwa Scarlet 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't they adorable! And it looks 
like there's quite a variety, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but wonder what kind of girls 
are there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet looked at the plushie with a 
joyful smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I was just looking. It's not like I 
actually wanted it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you insist on giving it to me, I 
suppose I'll accept it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So, um, you'd better do your best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
